name: ranked-bars
title: Ranked bars
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Horizontal share bars sorted by value, with a label, meta, and percent. admin-charts RankedBars stays the analytics card.

meta.descriptionEs: Barras horizontales ordenadas por valor, con etiqueta, meta y porcentaje.

api.name: items
api.description: id, label, value, and optional meta or share.

api.name: sort
api.description: Default desc. Ties break on id.

api.name: layout
api.description: Label over the bar, or label, bar, and value in one row.

docs: Independent implementation of a common dashboard pattern. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
